You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. Do NOT run a formatter on YAML or markdown. You own only: storygame/runtime/*.py; data/stories/continuity-initiative/{handoffs.yaml,knowledge.yaml,storylet-routes.yaml,storylets.md,plot.md,world.yaml}; files under tests/; bench/affordance_known_gaps.json; scripts/ringer/affordance/3c_cue_gate_probe.py. Edit nothing else (not storygame/story_package/*). Keep storygame/runtime story-agnostic: no scene id, fact id or story name in runtime code.

CONTEXT. HEAD already holds a work-in-progress commit ("WIP: 3C storylet split, cue wiring and cues"). See what it changed with `git show --stat HEAD` and `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD`. It splits storylet SL-3C-C into SL-3C-C (pumps) and SL-3C-F (surface gates), and SL-3C-D into SL-3C-D (reports) and SL-3C-G (families); it adds seven scene-3C cue deliveries to handoffs.yaml; it opens cue staging in resolution scenes in storygame/runtime/engine.py; and it adds tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py. Keep all of that. It is blocked by ONE loader rule, in storygame/story_package/loader.py near line 953 (read it, do not edit it): every resolution event's activation facts (all_facts_true and any_of) must be guaranteed at scene entry or produced by an EARLIER resolution event, because the Deadline backstop must be able to finish the chain with no player input. The WIP broke that rule by adding facts that reveals establish (evacuation_route_open, los_angeles_facility_lost, community_rescue_efforts_begun) to the activations of resolution_escape and resolution_complete. The package then fails to load: `scene 3C resolution event 'resolution_escape' needs 'evacuation_route_open', which entry does not guarantee`.

YOUR TASK (two changes).
1. In data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml put every resolution event's `activation` back to what it was before the WIP (`git show HEAD~1:data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml`; compare event by event). Keep the WIP's realization_storylets lists (resolution_escape lists SL-3C-C and SL-3C-F; resolution_network_consequences lists SL-3C-D and SL-3C-G; resolution_complete lists all of them). The both-parts rule then comes from realization_storylets: in play an event commits only after all its storylets have fired (canonical_events.py), and the Deadline backstop force-fires them. Do not touch the other WIP edits unless the package fails to load because of them.
2. Cue source. In storygame/runtime/engine.py `_bridge_delivery_fact_ids()` the WIP's resolution loop reads facts from event activations, which no longer name the part facts. Change the resolution part so the cue source is: for each of the scene's unfired resolution events, in event order, for each of its realization_storylets that has NOT fired, take the facts that storylet's realizations assert (storylet.realizations[*].operations with op assert), keep those that have a FactDelivery and are not yet true, no duplicates. Also keep the activation-missing facts as the WIP does, appended after. Bridge-event behavior and scenes with no resolution events must not change. Add a short docstring line saying the cue points at what the remaining required storylets would establish.

Then confirm the intended cue order with the tests already in tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py (fix a test only if it encoded the broken activation design; list each change in notes.md): at entry the cue is truth_no_longer_containable; then rebecca_captured; then the C parts (evacuation_route_open and los_angeles_facility_lost, only the missing one after one part is done); then the D parts (national_network_fragmenting and community_rescue_efforts_begun, only the missing one after one is done); then phase_two_conflict_plan_known. Also confirm: the pointer sentences on c_r1, c_r2, d_r1, d_r2 are gone; the full suite passes; the first-turn cue safety test passes for all seven cues; and the Deadline backstop still completes the chain (tests/test_resolution_cascade.py).

HOW TO RUN TESTS. In this sandbox `uv run` cannot write its cache or download. Use the main checkout's environment but make Python import THIS worktree's code: `PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`. First run `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame,sys;print(storygame.__file__)"` and confirm the path is inside your working directory; if it is not, stop and say so in notes.md instead of testing against the wrong code. Use the same interpreter for ruff: `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix . && /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format .` (ruff must not touch YAML or markdown; the repo is kept fully ruff-formatted).

OUTPUT. Write notes.md at the worktree root: what you changed, the final test result (counts), each test you changed and why, and anything you could not satisfy. Do not claim the suite passes unless you ran it and saw it pass.
